newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hong Kong Bank cuts NZ floating mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Bank cuts NZ floating mortgage rate.

text.p: Hong Kong Bank said on Friday it had cut its floating home lending rate in New Zealand to 9.6 percent from 9.75 percent.
Hong Kong Bank, a local unit of HSBC Holdings, said the move was effective immediately for new customers, and from April 16 for existing customers.
Personal Banking Manager Alex Bentley said the bank was also offering a special package of fee reductions and inducements in a bid to entice customers..

"There were signs of a slowing in the real estate market as we move into the autumn-winter period," Bentley said, explaining the bank's latest move in the highly-competitive New Zealand home loans market.
